info.title: ShopFloor Twin MES API
info.description: Read-only API of the MES (Phase 4): equipment with current state, state intervals, telemetry series, shift totals and the plant clock. No authentication yet (Phase 9); bound to loopback by default. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Push: WebSocket at /api/v1/ws (see docs/api/realtime.md).

type.description: Always about:blank: the status says it all

Problem.description: An error (RFC 9457 problem details), served as application/problem+json

get.summary: Readiness: migrated, database answers, subscribed to the UNS
Every equipment with its place in the hierarchy and its current state

epoch.description: Device epoch (run) the state belongs to

seq.description: The fact's sequence number; null when only the anchor is known

provisionalUntil.description: How far the open interval is stored (provisional, moves with the watermark)

ageMs.description: Time in this state up to the epoch's watermark (simulation ms)

anyOf.description: The equipment's latest state, in its newest device epoch

current.description: Null while the equipment never reported

get.summary: State intervals overlapping a time range
get.description: The stored pieces (each inside one UTC hour and one shift) are merged back into whole intervals and clipped to the range. Per shift, use /shifts/{date}/{shift}/totals.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (exclusive), ISO 8601; at most 7 days after `from`

truncated.description: True when the range held more pieces than one response takes

start.description: Start, clipped to the requested range

end.description: End, clipped to the requested range

provisional.description: The open interval: its end moves with the watermark

intervalStart.description: Where the whole interval starts (may be before `from`)

startSeq.description: The fact that opened it; null for an anchor

intervals.description: State intervals, the stored hour and shift pieces merged back, by start

get.summary: The equipment's telemetry metrics with unit and latest sample
Telemetry series, decimated into time buckets (min, max, avg)
get.description: The range is cut into at most maxPoints buckets of equal width, aligned on `from` (TimescaleDB time_bucket); each non-empty bucket gives min, max, average and count.

anyOf.description: A telemetry metric, the last segment of its UNS topic

items.description: A telemetry metric, the last segment of its UNS topic

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metrics to return (repeat the parameter for several, up to 8); default: all

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (exclusive), ISO 8601; at most 31 days after `from`

parameters.name: maxPoints
parameters.description: Most buckets per metric (2 to 5000, default 1000)

bucketMs.description: Width of each bucket; buckets are aligned on `from`

get.summary: Time per state in one shift, per equipment and epoch

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Shift date (the day the shift starts, Istanbul)

parameters.name: shift
parameters.description: Shift id from the shift pattern, for example A

provisionalMs.description: The part of `ms` in the open interval

get.summary: The site and the plant clock (watermark of the newest epoch)

site.description: Null before master data is seeded

watermark.description: Latest source time seen in that epoch (simulation time)

clock.description: The newest epoch and its watermark: the plant clock

watermark.description: Latest source time seen in that epoch (simulation time)

epochs.description: Every epoch seen since start-up, newest first
